answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake tied to one hardware-verified key before it can exchange services. A newcomer starts at its nadir, with tiny limits, and must wander through real, attested work before earning larger trust, while the vine of peer endorsements makes fake identities visible when one key signs twice. A challenge then slashes the stake, so forging a thousand Sybils costs a thousand stakes and keys, turning cheap fakery into an expensive, traceable gamble.
